employees.title: Manage Employees
employees.name: Full Name
employees.deactivateConfirmBody: {name} will no longer be able to sign in and will drop out of lists and the org chart. Their records are kept, and you can reactivate them later.
employees.tempPasswordHint: Hand this password to the employee. It cannot be recovered after you close this page.
employees.allocHint: Leave this employee already has on day one, credited once. For a new hire this is normally 0 — the monthly accrual below builds the balance up. Use it to carry a balance over from the paper records. It is added on top of accrual and is not limited by the yearly cap below.
employees.allocWarn: Employee created, but setting leave balance failed:
employees.policyHint: What this employee earns each month, added to their current balance. Accrual starts from the current Jalali month — not the hire date — so someone added mid-year earns only the remaining months of that year.
employees.policyAnnualCapHint: The most that can be earned in one Jalali year — the employee's annual entitlement. 0 means no cap. Only monthly accrual counts toward it; balances set by hand do not.
employees.policyCarryCapHint: The most that survives into the next Jalali year. At Nowruz anything above this is forfeited. 0 means unused leave is lost each year.
employees.policyWarn: Employee created, but saving the accrual policy failed:
employees.defaultQuotaHint: Default leave quotas are assigned to the new employee automatically.

regen.confirmBody: New passwords will be generated for {count} people and their old passwords stop working immediately.

list.title: Employees
list.lockedHint: Locked columns can only be changed by admins and HR. You can edit the name and hire date of your direct reports.

duration.restNote: Plus {minutes} minutes (from hourly leave) not shown here. They are kept when you save.

errors.mixedSign: For a negative amount, put the minus sign on both days and hours.
errors.hoursTooLarge: Hours must be less than one working day ({max} at most).

employees.lockedAdmin: Only an admin can change an admin's department, manager, title, roles or status.

departments.title: Departments
departments.createdHint: You can now add employees to this department.
departments.nameRequired: Both the Farsi and English names are required.

settings.weekendHint: Days that do not count as working days.
settings.anchorHint: Pick any date that IS a day off. The app alternates from it, so the following week is worked and the one after is off again.
settings.hoursHint: Hourly leave requests must fall inside this window, and are capped per day.
settings.recurringHint: Recurring holidays must still be entered for each year; day counting only treats the exact saved dates as holidays.

departments.title: Departments
departments.hint: Tap a department to see who works in it.
departments.noMembers: No one is assigned to this department.
departments.ownDepartmentManager: Only an admin can change the manager of your own department.

accrual.title: Monthly leave accrual
accrual.hint: Accrual runs on its own whenever a balance is opened. Use this to post the current month for everyone at once and see the result.
accrual.nothingToDo: Everything was already up to date.

approvalSteps.title: Request approval steps
approvalSteps.hint: Every request must be signed by all the active steps below.
approvalSteps.orderEnforced: Require the order to be followed
approvalSteps.orderHint: Off: either approver may sign first. On: they must sign in the numbered order.
approvalSteps.inactiveApprover: This person’s account is disabled — requests needing this signature cannot be completed.
approvalSteps.removeConfirm: Signatures already collected are kept; only the requirement is removed.
approvalSteps.orderAdminOnly: Only an administrator can change whether the order is binding.
approvalSteps.departmentHint: The requester's department manager (Settings → Departments) also signs, unless they are the direct manager or the requester. Once active, pending requests need this signature too.

addStep.title: Add an approval step
addStep.intro: Require another signature on every request — either from anyone holding a role, or from one specific person.
addStep.personHint: Only this person can sign this step — not even an administrator can sign in their place.

holidayImport.title: Bulk upload holidays
holidayImport.intro: Upload a CSV file of official holidays. Download the template first so the columns match.
holidayImport.templateHint: Dates may be Persian (1405/01/01) or Gregorian (2026-03-21). "Repeats yearly" accepts yes/no.
holidayImport.recurringWarning: Repeats yearly is a note only. Persian holidays do not fall on the same Gregorian day each year, so every year’s dates must be uploaded.
holidayImport.willUpdate: {count} already listed and will be overwritten
holidayImport.problemsTitle: Fix these lines and upload again

errors.missingColumn: A required column is missing from the header row.
errors.dupInFile: This date appears more than once in the file.
errors.noRows: The file has no holiday rows.

import.title: Bulk employee import
import.intro: Download the template, fill it in Excel, and upload it here. Starred columns are required. Rows may be in any order; hire dates may be Jalali or Gregorian. A department is matched by its code, or by name if the code is empty — departments that do not exist yet are created.
import.templateHint: Filled example (do not enter these rows). The supervisor column is the person's direct supervisor; the manager column is their department manager. Remaining leave is in days and hours, and may be negative:

errors.missingColumn: A required column is missing — use the template file.
errors.dupInFile: Personnel number is duplicated within this file.
errors.dupExisting: This personnel number is already registered.
errors.badDeptCode: Department code must be 2-4 latin letters or digits.
errors.deptNamesRequired: A new department needs both its Farsi and English name.
errors.deptCodeConflict: This department code is used with two different names in the file.
errors.unknownSupervisor: Supervisor not found in this file or among existing employees.
errors.unknownManager: Manager not found in this file or among existing employees.
errors.refNotManager: The supervisor/manager referenced must have the manager role.
errors.selfReference: A person cannot be their own supervisor or manager.
errors.badRole: Role must be manager or employee.
errors.badBalance: Remaining leave must be whole numbers (days at most 366).
errors.mixedSign: Days and hours must have the same sign.
errors.hoursTooLarge: Hours must be less than one workday — carry full days into the days column.
errors.deptManagerTie: This department's manager is ambiguous — two managers have the same number of people in it.

warnings.supervisorManagerMismatch: The supervisor {supervisor} reports to a different manager than this row's {manager}.
warnings.deptNamesDiffer: Department {code} already exists with different names — the existing names are kept.
warnings.deptManagerKept: Department {code} already has a different manager, which is kept.
warnings.bothSign: Department manager {departmentManager} will also sign this person's requests.

import.balanceDateHint: The date the remaining-leave figures in the file were counted to. Required.
import.balanceDateFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
import.accrualStarts: Balances include {month}. Monthly accrual starts from {start}.
import.departmentsHint: Departments marked new will be created. The manager shown signs every request from that department alongside the supervisor, once the department-manager approval step is on.
import.ackDepartments: I have checked the departments that will be created.

modes.title: Import mode
modes.addHint: Create the people who are not in the app yet. A personnel number that already exists is an error. Nothing else changes.
modes.updateHint: Also update people already in the app (name, title, department, supervisor/manager, manager role). The file overwrites the names and manager of every department it uses. Nobody else is touched.
modes.replace: Replace — the file is the new source of truth
modes.replaceHint: Add & update, plus: people not in the file are deactivated or kept (you choose), and unused empty departments are deleted. Admin accounts are never touched.
modes.overwriteBalancesHint: Set each updated person's annual balance to the file's value as of the balance date. Leave recorded in the app after that date is not re-counted.
modes.replaceConfirmBody: {create} will be created, {update} updated, {deactivate} deactivated, and {deleteDepartments} empty departments deleted. This runs as one step; nothing changes if it fails.
modes.doneNotDeleted: Not deleted (still have people in them): {codes}

plan.pendingSignerChanges: {count} pending requests will get a different approver.
plan.missingHint: Active employees who are not in the file. Choose what happens to them; admins are not listed.
plan.conflictsHint: These kept people conflict with the file. Choose an option for each before importing.

conflict.sameName: {name} (no. {oldPersonnelNo}) has the same name as no. {personnelNo} in the file — probably the same person.
conflict.managerDeactivated: {name}'s manager, {manager}, is or will be deactivated.
conflict.deptManagerReplaced: {name} manages department {code}, but the file gives it to {newManager}.

option.pickManager: Pick a manager from the file

plan.keptHint: They still have people (active or deactivated) in them, so they are not deleted.

bulk.title: Personal information: export and import
bulk.intro: Download everyone’s personal information, or fill it in for many people at once from a spreadsheet.
